name: DJI
summary: Drone and camera maker. Studio product tiles, engineering-blue pills, tight Open Sans
description: An analysis of DJI's design language — a product-photography showroom for drones and cameras, where full-bleed studio renders sit in square, gutter-separated tiles on a white canvas, every action is a rounded pill in a single engineering blue, type is a tightly tracked Open Sans set in near-black ink at stepped opacities, small orange tier labels mark product rank, and the store layers 8px option cards, a sticky purchase bar and pale grey panels on top of the same restrained system before closing on a charcoal footer.

colors.name: DJI Blue
colors.role: the brand-site action colour: nav Store pill, "Buy Now" pills, the active model selector, "Where to Buy" pills and the announcement-bar link.

colors.name: Store Blue
colors.role: the store's action colour: Buy Now, Add to Cart label, the selected option ring, the DJI Care tag and inline store links.

colors.name: Store Blue Tint
colors.role: the pale fill of Add to Cart.

colors.name: Link Blue
colors.role: "Learn More ›" and "Buy Now ›" text links on product and explore cards.

colors.name: Tier Orange
colors.role: small eyebrows that mark product rank.

colors.name: Badge Orange
colors.role: the corner badge on a highlighted store option.

colors.name: Canvas Soft
colors.role: feature-link band, store panels, In the Box tiles, footnote panel and the store footer.

colors.name: Panel
colors.role: the product benefits panel.

colors.name: Fog
colors.role: Explore More band, product-card backdrop and the Other Regions pill.

colors.name: Announce

colors.name: Lines
colors.role: `{colors.hairline}` (#f0f0f0) tab track, `{colors.divider}` (#e8e8e8) FAQ and purchase-bar rules, `{colors.card-border}` (#d9d9d9) option cards, `{colors.dashed-border}` (#dddddd) unavailable option, `{colors.input-border}` (#d4d7d9) store email field, `{colors.control-border}` (#cccccc) steppers and checkboxes.

colors.name: Ink
colors.role: headings and body on white.

colors.name: Ink Secondary
colors.role: secondary copy, inactive tabs.

colors.name: Ink Tertiary
colors.role: product-tile eyebrows.

colors.name: Store Ink
colors.role: store product and option titles.

colors.name: Graphite

colors.name: Nav Ink

colors.name: Slate
colors.role: store footer links and the dark footer's field border.

colors.role: spec captions in the comparison table.

colors.name: Footer Link
colors.role: links on the charcoal footer.

colors.name: Error
colors.role: "Out of Stock" on unavailable store options.
